evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth: 8.4 → 17.1 → 22.9 → 30.8 ppm, well above the ~7 ppm purged baseline
Tube pressure creeping up 3.04 → 3.27 Torr with Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm
MFC steady at setpoint, so pressure rise is not from flow change
Temperature control at setpoint 750 °C, heater power stable ~44%

args.missing_evidence: Continued O2/pressure trend (or a brief Ar-flow step / pump-down test) to confirm air ingress rather than outgassing; leak-rate check at constant flow would discriminate seal leak from exhaust restriction.
